title: Tool Metadata Schema
description: Schema for tool-metadata.json files inside tool subprojects. Provides a machine-readable description and CDM-output-manifest for a tool, information not captured by rickshaw.json (deployment/lifecycle only). Two shapes exist: tools that decompose into independently-selectable subtools (declare 'subtools'; put CDM info on each subtool entry) and tools that do not (declare 'cdm_indexed'/'cdm_sources'/'output_files' directly).

rickshaw-tool-metadata.description: Metadata block containing the schema version for this tool-metadata.json file format.

version.description: The schema version this file conforms to. Currently must be '2026.08.11'.

tool.description: The tool name. Must match the 'tool' field in this subproject's rickshaw.json.

description.description: A human-readable, one-to-few-sentence description of what this tool collects and why someone would enable it.

subtools.description: Declare for tools that decompose into independently-selectable subtools (e.g. 'kernel' wraps turbostat/perf/intel-speed-select/trace-cmd/sysfs-trace; 'sysstat' wraps mpstat/sar/iostat/pidstat), typically chosen via a comma-separated '--subtools' parameter. When present, omit the top-level 'cdm_indexed'/'cdm_sources'/'output_files' properties; put that information on each subtool entry instead. Omit this property entirely for tools with a single, undivided collection process.

name.description: The subtool's name, exactly as it appears as a value in the tool's comma-separated subtool-selection parameter (e.g. 'turbostat', 'mpstat'). Keep in sync with any subtool-name validation regex in this tool's multiplex.json.

description.description: A human-readable, one-to-few-sentence description of what this subtool collects.

cdm_indexed.description: Whether this subtool's data is indexed into the Common Data Model (CDM) by the tool's post-processing script. If false, the subtool's output is only available via 'output_files'.

cdm_sources.description: Present when 'cdm_indexed' is true. The CDM metric_desc 'source' value(s) this subtool's data is filed under, and the metric 'type' name(s) emitted under each source. Descriptive metadata only -- not enforced at runtime against the post-processing script. The vocabulary for metric_desc's 'class'/'default-aggregation' fields is defined authoritatively in subprojects/core/toolbox/python/toolbox/cdm_metrics.py (VALID_CLASSES / VALID_AGGREGATIONS) and is intentionally not duplicated here.

items.description: One CDM source produced by this subtool.

source.description: The CDM metric_desc 'source' value (e.g. 'procstat', 'sar-net', 'mpstat'). Note a single subtool can emit multiple distinct sources (e.g. sysstat's 'sar' subtool emits 'sar-mem', 'sar-io', 'sar-tasks', 'sar-scheduler', 'sar-net').

types.description: The CDM metric_desc 'type' value(s) emitted under this source.

output_files.description: Raw (non-CDM, or supplementary-to-CDM) output file names this subtool leaves in the collector's working directory (e.g. 'turbostat-stdout.txt').

cdm_indexed.description: For tools without 'subtools' only. Whether this tool's data is indexed into the Common Data Model (CDM) by its post-processing script.

cdm_sources.description: For tools without 'subtools' only. Present when 'cdm_indexed' is true. Same shape and vocabulary note as 'subtools[].cdm_sources' above.

items.description: A CDM metric_desc 'type' value emitted under this source.

output_files.description: For tools without 'subtools' only. Raw output file names this tool leaves in the collector's working directory, for output not captured by 'cdm_sources'.

oneOf.description: Tools with independently-selectable subtools: CDM info lives per-subtool, not at the top level.
Tools without subtools: a single, undivided collection process. 'cdm_indexed' is required so every tool has a definite answer either way.
